﻿[size=3][b]Paul[/b] is back and better than ever! After 5 long years of collecting dust, this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3414]mod[/url]﻿ has finally gotten the revamp it deserves with [b]all new dialogue[/b], [b]heart events[/b], [b]portraits[/b], [b]sprites[/b], and sooo much more. 

                   [img]https://i.ibb.co/wS53PYp/IMG-0255.png[/img]﻿[/size]﻿[size=3]
Some of you may know that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3414]Paul the Optometrist[/url]﻿ started in 2019 as a simple mod to put my lovely irl husband in the game. After returning to [b]SDV[/b] and seeing all the love my little mod had received, I just had to dust off my long-forgotten modding skills and give it a serious [b]refresh[/b]. One super-fun hyperfixation later and  we’ve got ourselves an [b]entirely new mod[/b] for [b]1.6[/b]! 
[/size]
[size=3]I hope y’all enjoy it as much as I have and please feel free to reach out with any [b]bugs[/b], [b]questions[/b], or [b]feedback[/b]! Thanks!
[/size]
[quote]
[b]Paul[/b] never dreamed he’d end up in a place like [b]Pelican Town[/b]. However, when the search for answers brings him to the valley, he finds that he may discover much more than he was looking for.

[b]Sweet[/b], [b]hard-working[/b], and [b]responsible[/b] - [b]Paul[/b] brings his love of nature and passion for science to the valley. He is [b]romanceable[/b] and has [b]11 brand new events[/b] as well as  [b]6 seasonal outfit variations[/b], a changing [b]schedule[/b], and probably [b]way too many lines of dialogue[/b]. (Thank you English Lit degree lol.)[/quote]
        ﻿[/size]            [img]https://i.ibb.co/6ZtQy9q/IMG-0256.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][center][size=3][size=3][b]

Paul[/b] can usually be found at the [b]clinic[/b] during work hours ([b]9 am[/b] to [b]3 pm[/b]) or off somewhere reading a good book. He frequents [b]Demetrius’ Lab[/b], the [b]Library[/b], the [b]Beach[/b], and the [b]Forest Lake[/b]. 
[/size]
[size=3]Not only does his [b]schedule[/b] change with the storyline, but his after-work activities shift with the [b]season[/b] and [b]day of the week[/b]. Though not exact, you can find a rough outline of his [b]weekday[/b] whereabouts below:

[spoiler][b]6:30 am[/b] - reading by the [b]Community Center[/b]
[b]8:30 am[/b] - working in the [b]Clinic[/b]
[b]11:00 am[/b] - shopping at the [b]Seed Shop[/b] or reading outside the [b]Clinic[/b]
[b]12:30 pm[/b] - working in the [b]Clinic[/b]
[b]3:00 pm[/b] - at [b]Demetrius’ Lab[/b] (before [b]Eight Heart Event[/b]), in [b]Town[/b] in the [b]Spring[/b], the [b]Beach[/b] in the [b]Summer[/b],  the [b]Forest[/b] in the [b]Fall[/b], [b]Willy’s Shop[/b] in the [b]Winter[/b], and the [b]Saloon[/b] every [b]Friday[/b]
[b]11:00 pm[/b] - heading Home

On[b] rainy days[/b] you can find him in the [b]Library[/b] all day.
[/size]
